E1_coarse_regime.question: Does richness-like visitor exposure position the mean real-world response regime?
E1_coarse_regime.exposure: block observed visitor richness, always reported with monitored flower-hours and zero-visit windows; controlled-effective visitor-group count is a secondary richness-like measure
E1_coarse_regime.role: empirical counterpart of synthetic richness-sensitive coarse regime placement

E2_branch.question: After richness-like exposure is accounted for, does realized composition interacting with plant starting state explain residual branch identity?
E2_branch.composition: block visitor composition, with controlled SVD-weighted effective-service composition preferred when background-controlled SVD exists
E2_branch.starting_state: pre-outcome same-plant floral geometry / functional position
E2_branch.role: empirical counterpart of synthetic realized composition x starting-state branching

E3_propagation.question: Is the ecological chain transition-linked within the same plants/blocks?
E3_propagation.role: prospective real-chain confrontation of the synthetic mechanism

model_selection_boundary.distribution_family_and_replication_requ: chosen only after frozen pilot dispersion/diagnostic review using outcome-blind rules where possible

claim_boundary: E1-E3 can establish a contemporary transition-linked hierarchy in Izu. They do not alone identify the historical origin of the pollinator community, evolutionary selection, or a causal geographic boundary.
